name: foreign-trade-customer-operations
description: Codex skill plugin for salesperson-controlled cold outreach, unanswered follow-up, customer reply communication, and local customer-operation records.

interface.shortDescription: Prepare controlled cold outreach, follow-up, replies, and customer-operation materials.
interface.longDescription: A salesperson-controlled assistant for first outreach, unanswered follow-up, complete-thread replies, and customer-operation preparation. It can return traceable draft, follow-up, and risk projections to the salesperson workbench; it does not research prospects, choose customers, make commercial decisions, write actual-send facts without evidence, or send messages.
defaultPrompt: Use the customer-development handoff package to prepare a first cold-outreach draft for salesperson review.
Review this due follow-up and prepare a draft without sending it.
Analyze this complete customer reply thread and prepare a bilingual reply draft.
